{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./busco.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.
#
# NOTE: This script expects environment variables to be set before submission:
#   fasta=/path/to/input.fasta
#   outpath=/path/to/output_dir

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l walltime=20:00:00 -> -t 20h
#   -l ncpus=104         -> -n 1 -c 104
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 104 -t 20h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -N BUSCO not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: PBS -P xl04 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

  # NOTE: PBS -q normalsr not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the normalsr queue.

  # NOTE: PBS -l mem=512GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: PBS -j oe not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  # NOTE: PBS -l storage=... not translated.
  # Performance implication: if storage placement/quotas matter, I/O performance/availability may differ.

  # NOTE: PBS -l wd not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: working directory may differ; handled by cd below.

  # NOTE: PBS -l jobfs=100GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without local scratch reservation, heavy temporary I/O may be slower or run out of space.

  # NOTE: PBS -M (email) not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  module load singularity

  # inputs: fasta, outpath
  : "${fasta:?set fasta=/path/to/input.fasta}"
  : "${outpath:?set outpath=/path/to/output_dir}"

  lineage=/g/data/xl04/bpadata/Bassiana_duperreyi/projects/chromsyn/busco_downloads
  prefix=$(basename "${fasta}" .fasta)

  cd "${outpath}" || exit 1

  # Use Flux cores-per-task for BUSCO cpu setting.
  flux run -n 1 -c 104 \
    singularity exec /g/data/xl04/ka6418/docker_images/busco-5.4.7.sif \
      busco -o "run_${prefix}" --offline -i "$fasta" -l sauropsida_odb10 \
      --download_path "$lineage" --cpu 104 -m genome --tar
fi
"
}
